body:
Implements #215 backend tenant execution budgets in admission units, without changing subscription credits, commercial plans or provider credential semantics. Missing operator allocation fails closed. Draft remains open for parent integration and production acceptance.

Current candidate: `50598846e592dbdb4b9419f96eb99b6cf5b9edbf` on `codex/215-tenant-quota-20261025` (base `40cbaff`). Both configured CI workflows reached terminal success at this exact head. Full CI completed2026-10-25 19:17:39 UTC; prior-head checks are not used as evidence for these corrections.

- A PostgreSQL ledger serializes workspace budget, lifetime operator cap, concurrency, sliding rate limit, scoped idempotency, immutable settlement/refund/uncertain outcomes and shared Retry-After. Active membership and allocation are rechecked under the tenant lock. Admin policy cannot create or enlarge an operator allocation; usage GET and streamed body limits are enforced.
- Gates cover ordinary Agent generation/web tools, durable Coordinator model steps/summary/user enqueue, Decision Gateway, Composio and shared run queue/daemon claim/renew/complete/recovery. Existing fixed-rule fallback and subscription observations remain intact. Current main has no persistent schedule/cloud executor; #179/#172 must integrate these gates at their final boundary alongside #191/#208/#207.
- Independent-review corrections: daemon reservation creation, activation and queued-to-preparing run CAS now share one transaction/deadline; SQL faults or SIGKILL leave queued/no-reservation state. Legacy expired reserved/refunded rows recover only after a locked run read proves queued plus null quota binding/startedAt/lease; the old zero-unit refund stays immutable and one uniquely linked attempt is admitted under current limits. Already invoked/uncertain/settled/executing work cannot reissue payloads.
- Composio has actual transport cancellation for its whole operation below the original lease, bounded pagination and a final atomic lease/policy/auth/backoff check in the SDK's `beforeExecute` hook, after its internal schema/file preflight. Expired old calls cannot dispatch into a newly admitted slot. Invoked effects with lost responses remain uncertain and cannot resend. Actual SDK-wrapped HTTP 429 now refunds and persists Retry-After without retry. A minimal checked-in pnpm patch to locked client rc.19 keeps the caller signal connected to fetch body I/O after headers, verified by an actual headers/partial-JSON/body-stall socket-cancellation regression; dependency versions are unchanged.
- Removes the old candidate's added ordinary-Agent output-token cap to preserve existing model output semantics; execution time and retry limits remain. No frontend layout/design change.

Validation (local cloud Linux PG17.9 supporting evidence, plus clean exact-head CI PostgreSQL17 and actual built Next app; synthetic users/allocations and loopback services only):

- PG runner **18/18**, zero skips: **16 PG child scenarios + PG parent + one pure error/Retry-After test**. Includes ten-way contention, multi-owner/tenant isolation, allocation lifetime cap, policy/auth changes, actual SQL write faults and separate-worker SIGKILL inside atomic admission/claim binding, a separate legacy reserved worker killed before delayed restart past expiry, and before/after local HTTP effects.
- Real installed Composio SDK + HTTP + PG runner **8/8**, zero skips: **7 child scenarios + parent** (successful control, delayed accounts, delayed SDK-internal schema, actual pre-header socket cancellation/no late continuation, headers-then-stalled-body cancellation, real HTTP429 refund/backoff, confirmed effect then response loss/replay denial). Before-fix failures and SQL/HTTP evidence retained. A fail-only egress guard asserts zero external network attempts; SDK tracking/version probes are disabled in this synthetic test.
- Actual Next claim HTTP SQL-fault runner **1/1**: before fix 500/queued/unbound/executing then repeated409; the initial correction allowed immediate retry but real late-retry regression reproduced 409 after expiry; final fix returns503/queued/no-reservation. A seeded legacy orphan is expired, ambiguous startedAt history is rejected409, the proven-unsent retry succeeds200 with exactly one new binding and immutable old refund, duplicate409. No worker harness executed. Exact-head production Next API runner also passed **6/6**, zero skips (**5 functional child tests + parent**), including actual Agent10-way denials, Coordinator admission/model boundary and daemon10-way claim contention.
- Types/lint pass; remaining **18** standard script groups pass. Broader `pnpm check` is **not wholly green**: unchanged source assertions fail at `tests/agent-ui.test.mjs:39`, `:433` (hydration preload/Popover) and `tests/acceptance.test.mjs:7` (development HTTPS cookie regex). All three were actually rerun and fail identically in a clean detached base `40cbaff` worktree. No layouts/auth/expectations were altered to conceal them. This differs from configured CI, which does not run these two files.

Exact-head terminal results:

- [Quota PG, actual SDK HTTP and production Next API/claim regressions](https://github.com/alexj11324/Mikka/actions/runs/40224079921): **success**, completed19:04:50 UTC; runner counts18/8/6/1, all zero skips.
- [Strict policy/types/lint, production build, performance and browser regressions](https://github.com/alexj11324/Mikka/actions/runs/40224079959): **success**, completed19:17:39 UTC; performance **5 passed**, browser **75 passed / 1 existing intentional skip**. CLA and GitGuardian also pass. Same-repository duplicate PR jobs and real-credential OIDC remain intentionally skipped.

Evidence/contract/limits: `docs/backend/215-tenant-quotas.md`; private cloud evidence `/workspace/evidence-215/` retains SHA/environment/UTC, before/after failures, actual SQL state and network observations. The earlier artifact download was denied HTTP403 by the artifact distribution host; it was not retried or bypassed. Authorized CI logs remain readable. No genuine UI/production recording is claimed.

Release gates: parent freezes integrated SHA/unique preview, authorizes a non-production allocation and runs real user/provider-safe acceptance with usage readback. No production policy/allocation exists; applying this fail-closed change before provisioning denies execution. No main merge, production migration/deploy, IAM/credential change, live-credit consumption or billable resource creation was performed. OIDC credential-access CI is deliberately skipped for this branch. Keep #215 open pending integrated acceptance and independent review.


Adapter handoff for #269/#264 (quota source stays frozen at this head):

- Server-only quota entry points: `beginQuota({ownerId,key,resource,binding,leaseMs})`, `tenantQuotas.revalidate(ownerId,id)` and immutable `finish(ownerId,id,outcome,usage?,retryAfter?)`; `reserveBound(request, DB-only bind, optional locked unsent proof)` is available for atomic app-DB domain binding. Keys must be stable backend operation identities; returned workspace must match the trusted captured domain workspace. No public allocation grant/boolean bypass exists.
- Schedule49a150fe: missing actual generation boundary is `scheduledAgent.read(ownerId,task,operationId)`. Carry persisted workspace/occurrence/version/lease context; gate actual generation with stable operationId and explicitly operator-approved resource, preserve45s/no-retry, and pass stable operation/step/call keys as fourth argument to gated Composio calls. A publication rollback after a paid result requires durable #208/#176 result/outcome checkpoint; quota settlement is not a reply cache. Existing queueRun/daemon gates must not be duplicated.
- Policy721bbf3: managed positives remain `policyBudgetUnavailable` until an invocation lifecycle adapter exists. The current `authorize():Promise<void>` hook alone cannot settle streamed/body work. Reuse and finally revalidate existing Agent/Coordinator reservation context at the actual policy-locked send boundary, rather than charging those units twice; enforce captured workspace/resource/owner/route. Keep policy revocation/tuple checks, whole-operation cancellation and uncertain replay refusal. App quota DB and workspace policy DB are separate; no distributed atomicity is claimed. Managed native/child/tool transports stay denied until independently enforced.
- Parent must integrate a frozen combined SHA and provision approved isolated allocation/policy before positive tests/flags. Real ten-way mixed entry contention, delayed revocation/expiry, crash/retry, provider429/body stall and result-publication failure with ledger/domain readback are required before enabling. No production allocation/live provider usage is authorized or claimed. Detailed contract retained at private `/workspace/evidence-215/adapter-contract-5059884.md`.
